title: Placing M-Phasis on the Plurality of Hate: A Feature-Based Corpus of Hate Online

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a feature-based corpus of user comments from migration-related news articles and annotating agent-evaluation-victim triples to measure negative evaluations, explicit/implicit hate, and harmful action recommendations targeting migrants.

Qualitative error analysis of model predictions to identify instances of over-blacklisting (false positives), where classifiers spuriously associate specific political figures, institutions, or countries with negative sentiment due to dataset imbalances.

Analyzing cosine similarity of sentence embeddings to group mainstream vs. fringe media comments, and evaluating how this domain imbalance affects classifier performance (Macro F1) on under-represented domains.
